children: Brown & Brown posted higher third-quarter profit and revenue, with growth in commission and fees revenue.
The insurance brokerage on Monday posted a profit of $240 million, or 67 a share, compared with $227 million, or 68 cents a share, a year earlier.
On an adjusted basis, earnings were $1.07. Analysts polled by FactSet expected $1.09 a share.
Revenue rose 7.4% to $1.73 billion. Analysts expected $1.76 billion.
Commission and fees revenue rose to $1.7 billion from $1.55 billion. The company's investment and other income segment fell to $25 million from $56 million.
Chief Executive J. Powell Brown said the quarter reflected the company's efforts to win more customers amid a "challenging rate environment."
